input.title: 2022 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 180
input.descriptionHtml:
Save Big on our 2022 Model Clearance!
All boats are new and come with a full warranty starting on their purchase date!

2024 Models can be found here and will be available once delivered from Hobie

Financing Available*!


Hobie's original Pro Angler packs extreme fishing utility, with scads of (that's six) horizontal rod holders, enough tackle compartments to empty a store, and an elevated Vantage ST seat that's as much easy chair as captain's perch. There's a non-skid deck for standing - a huge advantage for sight fishing - and veritable acres of H-Rail for mounting rod holders and electronics. All this on a spacious 14-foot platform, with no need for a gas tank. Hobie's unique MirageDrive 180 with Glide Technology provides efficient, quiet propulsion.

Length: 13' 8" / 4.17 m
Width: 38" / .97 m
Hull Weight: 120.5 lbs / 55 kg
Fully Rigged Weight: 144.5 lbs / 66 kg
Capacity: 600 lbs / 272 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity: 350 lbs / 159 kg
Crew: 1

*Must be approved by Synchrony Financial with a large enough credit line to cover the purchase price. Call (815) 433-2200 for more info
